literal: Having-hastened command will-obey the-world, systematically pleasantly speaking capable-ones if-obtained.
translation: If the world obtains those who are capable of speaking in a systematic and pleasant manner, it will quickly listen to and carry out their commands.
modern: கருத்துக்களை வரிசையாகவும் இனிமையாகவும் சொல்ல வல்லவர்களைப் பெற்றால், இவ்வுலகம் அவர்கள் ஏவும் கட்டளையை விரைந்து கேட்டுச் செய்யும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the power of effective communication. It states that if the world finds individuals who can present their thoughts in a logical, orderly sequence (நிரந்து) and in a pleasant, agreeable manner (இனிது), it will readily accept their leadership. The world will not only listen to them but will also hasten to execute their commands (தொழில் கேட்கும்). Thus, systematic and sweet speech is the key to gaining influence and authority over others.
